name: Gorj
summary: Gorj County is one of the 41 counties of Romania, located in the Oltenia region. The seat is in the municipality of Târgu Jiu.

sources.title: Ethnographic Zones – Museum of the Romanian Peasant
sources.excerpt: Located in NW Oltenia, on the middle course of the Jiu River. The Gorj ethnofolkloric zone is made up of the Jiu valley and the Sadului valley. Representative villages: Tismana, Polovragi, Baia de Fier, Arcani, Peștișani
